name: A. G. Cook
sources: style-research-extended-2 vol.2 pop-2020s — A. G. Cook
notes: PC Music founder; exaggerated, note-by-note-constructed hyperpop, and one of the fully documented entries here — construction method, vocal-chopping habit, stated influences and dated credits are all sourced. The drums are the entry's: "hard-clipped four-square kick, layered synthetic claps, and 16th hats; percussive density is pushed to the point of distortion. Fills are white-noise sweeps and pitched risers." So the kick is a hard four-on-the-floor, the clap stack is doubled at a zero offset, `hihat.fillDensity` is 0.74 — the highest in this section, which is what "pushed to the point of distortion" means as a number — and the fill lanes are `riser` and `impact` with the snare-roll ladder off. Harmony is deliberately archetypal and then buried: "bright majors and Eurodance minors held deliberately simple, then made strange by density — he builds chords and melodies note by note with virtual instruments and experiments with combining dissonant sounds, producing dense multi-layered arrangements influenced by Black MIDI technique." So the families are the plainest in this section while `halfStepDissonance` is 0.24, the highest authored here, and the melody `densityPerBar` reaches 16 — the note-by-note density is the parameter, not the harmony. The bass follows: "distorted saw or square sub locked to the kick; on the mechanised tracks the bass is a rapid arpeggiated figure rather than a sustained note (his stated arrangement model is the mechanised music of Conlon Nancarrow)", which is `independent_riff` at a high `followRootsProb` with four-note repeated cells and a high `anticipationProb`; no `bass808` block, because the entry names a saw sub rather than an 808. "Pitch-shifted, feminine-coded vocals … chopped into a rhythmic element above the melody" is the `bell_echo` counter at high density and the vocal-chop timbre. ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are every drum probability, the humanize pair, `bpm.mode` 130 (the research gives 100—160 with nightcore sections at the top, so the mode is the band's midpoint) and the `lydian` weight in `session.scales` — the entry says "bright majors and Eurodance minors held deliberately simple" and names no mode, so lydian is an inferred bright colour at weight 2. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 937/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** The 1-bar value came out of `melody.phraseBars`, which is now [2,4] weighted [3,4]. `generators::melody` writes a phrase's rhythm **once** and reuses it for every repeat, so a 1-bar phrase gives the whole clip one bar of rhythmic entropy — and the counter, whose onsets are read off the lead's, inherits that ceiling. Distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "pitch-shifted, feminine-coded vocals and bright synthetic textures are the house style; he prepares extensive demos, has collaborators record over them, then chops the vocals into a rhythmic element above the melody. Cited references are Max Martin's melodic craft and Scritti Politti's high-gloss pop.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
